heading: How can I reduce an animated GIF?
introduction: FileCompresser re-encodes animated GIF frames with a reduced color palette. Maximum mode also limits animation to 15 frames per second, trading smoothness for a possible size reduction.

sections.heading: Choose a mode for the animation
sections.body: Add the GIF and start with Recommended. Use Maximum when a lower frame rate is acceptable. Process the animation, then play the complete download rather than checking a single frame.

sections.heading: Review motion, colors and looping
sections.body: A smaller palette can affect gradients and subtle colors. A lower frame rate can make motion look less smooth. Recognized finite loop counts are preserved, but check the downloaded animation in the place where it will be used.

sections.heading: When browser processing needs a smaller input
sections.body: GIF encoding uses the media engine and can consume substantial memory. This tool accepts files up to 50 MB, but a long or complex animation may still exceed the resources available to your browser. Keep the source and try a shorter animation if processing fails.

seoTitle: GIF Compressor — Reduce Animated GIF Size
seoDescription: Optimize animated GIFs in your browser with palette reduction and an optional 15 fps limit. Review motion, colors, looping and actual output size.
